# The Grounds by Aldar

> Dubai’s first vitality community in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Independent launch site for 3–4 bedroom townhouses and villas by Aldar and Dubai Holding. Guide price from AED 2.85M; sales launch expected December 2026.

Prices, areas and payment schedules are indicative until Aldar publishes official sales documents. Register interest via the popup form on any page — it does not reserve a home.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thegrounds.ae/): Vitality community overview, homes, amenities and launch timeline.
- [Townhouses](https://thegrounds.ae/townhouses/): 3- and 4-bedroom townhouse types, sizes and guide pricing.
- [Villas](https://thegrounds.ae/villas/): Twin villas and detached villas with indicative areas.
- [Location](https://thegrounds.ae/location/): Dubai Silicon Oasis connectivity, schools and everyday access.
- [Brochure](https://thegrounds.ae/brochure/): Request the official brochure when published at launch.
- [Floor plans](https://thegrounds.ae/floor-plans/): Indicative layouts and room imagery; PDFs at launch.
- [Price list](https://thegrounds.ae/price-list/): Guide starting prices for each home type.
- [Payment plan](https://thegrounds.ae/payment-plan/): Typical 5% / 45% / 50% off-plan instalment schedule.

## Crawling & discovery

- [Sitemap index](https://thegrounds.ae/sitemap-index.xml): Entry point listing page and image sitemaps.
- [Page sitemap](https://thegrounds.ae/sitemap.xml): HTML URLs for the site.
- [Image sitemap](https://thegrounds.ae/sitemap-images.xml): Images with titles and captions per page.
- [Image map JSON](https://thegrounds.ae/images-map.json): Machine-readable media catalog (URLs, alt text, page associations).
- [LLM full guide](https://thegrounds.ae/llms-full.txt): Extended notes, media list and IndexNow details.

## Optional

- [Legacy prices page](https://thegrounds.ae/price-payment-plan/): Combined prices and payment copy; prefer price-list and payment-plan.
